Privacy

How we handle your details.

Last updated 9 November 2026. This notice covers the lamp interest list on vh.do.

Who is responsible

Vedh Krishnan, operating as v/h, is responsible for this list. For privacy questions or requests, email vedh@vh.do.

What you give us

Your email address, any optional price or placement preference you choose, when you join, and a record of the consent wording you accepted. You can leave both research questions unanswered.

What we use it for

With your consent, we use your email to send occasional updates about the v/h lamp. Optional answers help inform the design. Joining is not an order or a reservation, and we collect no payment details.

We do not sell this information or share it with advertisers. We do not use the list to send unrelated marketing.

Hosting and security

The website is hosted by GitHub Pages. The signup service and database are hosted by Cloudflare. These providers process requests, including network information such as IP addresses, to operate and protect their services. Processing may take place in the United States and other countries.

Our signup database does not store your IP address, location or browsing history. The service uses a hashed IP address temporarily to limit abusive requests. Our application does not log signup contents or use advertising cookies or analytics on this page.

How long we keep it

Your signup expires after 365 days. Expired records are excluded from the active list immediately and deleted by a daily cleanup job. Recovery copies held by our hosting provider can persist for up to 30 additional days before they expire.

Your choices

You can withdraw consent, unsubscribe, request a copy, correct your information or ask for deletion by emailing vedh@vh.do. Please use the address you signed up with so we can verify the request. We will include a way to unsubscribe in any update we send.

Depending on where you live, you may have additional privacy rights, including the right to complain to your local data protection authority. We will handle requests under the laws that apply.

Changes to this notice

We will update this page if the service changes. A different use of your details that requires consent will need your consent first.
